external_prior.title: Overnight Returns, Trading Constraints, and Future Stock Returns: Evidence from the Chinese A-Share Market
external_prior.authors: Rong Chen, Zhen Hu, Hai Lin
external_prior.independent_claim: Medium-term overnight returns have a positive relation with future A-share returns while intraday returns do not; T+1 delayed incorporation is the proposed mechanism.
external_prior.local_claim_boundary: The full paper implementation was not available from the accessible source. The 20-session monthly construction below is a frozen local canonical approximation, not a claimed exact replication.

why_not_a_repeat: Prior overnight/daytime tug-of-war required repeated positive-night/negative-day states and was chronologically mixed; overnight-information stability studied variability rather than direction. This experiment uses the raw 20-session cumulative overnight direction specified before outcomes and does not add a daytime sign condition.

population.security_universe: exact accepted Cycle-015 daily eligible liquid universe
population.decision_schedule: last accepted market session of each calendar month

predictor.signal: sum gap_return over t-19 through completed session t
predictor.orientation: higher cumulative overnight return is preferred
predictor.selection: 20 highest signal securities, ties by symbol ascending
predictor.opposite_arm: 20 lowest signal securities, ties by symbol ascending; diagnostic only

response.screen_return: expm1(sum of exact consecutive t+1 through t+20 action-aware step_return))
response.event_control: equal-weight mean of all response-complete eligible securities on the same decision date

temporal_sequence.fixed_validation: 2021-01-01 through 2023-12-31, opened only if every generation gate passes

post_result_action.if_both_gates_pass: Freeze one separate exact next-open executable portfolio contract before portfolio PnL.
post_result_action.if_generation_fails: Reject this exact local approximation; do not invert, change 20 sessions, alter Top-20, add intraday conditions, or open validation.

prohibited: lookback, holding, Top-N, month schedule, sign, daytime condition, or liquidity threshold search
Strategy A or Industry-Consensus Q1 modification or combination
portfolio PnL before both information gates pass
